digest.component_or_area: complexity linter gate and baseline maintenance
propositions: A shrink-only complexity baseline tracks production C901 findings above threshold 15 per AST-qualified function identity to prevent new or increased complexity debt while allowing reductions

The baseline wrapper exits zero only when all current Ruff findings match or are below recorded ceilings, failing on new/increased debt or scanner/schema errors; --update-stale maintenance mode refuses to write if any debt increased
Ruff C901 threshold 15 is centralized in pyproject.toml and enforced by the wrapper during make lint over src/rebar scope, independent of existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests

The baseline schema requires UTF-8 JSON with schema_version 1, sorted ceiling entries keyed by repository-relative-POSIX-path::qualified-symbol, integer ceilings >15, and rejects duplicates and unknown fields via strict loading

Scanner return codes 0 and 1 with valid C901 JSON both proceed to counter comparison (active/new/increased/stale), while missing Ruff, return code 2+, invalid JSON, non-C901 output, or duplicate keys cause wrapper failure
